Definition: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
BiblicalUsage: 1) to seek, require, desire, exact, request; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to seek to find; 1a2) to seek to secure; 1a3) to seek the face; 1a4) to desire, demand; 1a5) to require, exact; 1a6) to ask, request; 1b) (Pual) to be sought
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
